outcome: Modified Bromage scale duration for motor block (MB1-2-3)
cohort: Pregnant women who underwent cesarean section surgery at Giresun Obstetrics and Pediatrics Education and Research Hospital between March 15, 2023, and July 15, 2023.
finding: Statistically significant differences were found between several preoperative inflammatory markers (NLR, SII, SIRI, PIV, PLR, MPV) and various measures of sensory and motor block duration and reversal times in patients who received spinal anesthesia for cesarean section.
